text.en: Fine-Tuning is row 71 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Fine-Tuning 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 71 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Fine-Tuning with “Fine-Tuning can Distort Pretrained Features and Underperform Out-of-Distribution”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Fine-Tuning 与论文《Fine-Tuning can Distort Pretrained Features and Underperform Out-of-Distribution》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Ananya Kumar, Percy Liang”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Ananya Kumar（官方页拼写）、Percy Liang（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Ananya Kumar, Percy Liang”。
